NODE — agriculture
2026-07-15 · Jane Contributor · EN

A solar-powered soil moisture node on mioty

I set out to monitor soil moisture across a hillside vineyard with no cellular coverage and no mains power nearby. mioty’s long range and tiny power draw made it possible to run a node on a small solar panel and a supercapacitor instead of a battery that would need replacing.

This is example content — replace it with a real submission, or remove this file once contributors start sending their own.
